cards.a: The classic point-to-point WAN protocol that succeeded HDLC, adding authentication (PAP/CHAP), multilink bonding, and negotiation via LCP/NCP. It is also the framing that PPPoE rides on.

cards.q: What is the four-part PPP stack?
cards.a: LCP (link control, setup and options), NCP (network control, e.g. IP), authentication (PAP/CHAP, verifies peers), and PPP framing (encapsulation).

cards.q: What are the four LCP phases of a PPP link?
cards.a: 1) Link established via LCP, 2) authentication (PAP/CHAP), 3) NCP (IPCP), 4) data phase. The link is up only if all phases pass.

cards.q: How does PAP differ from CHAP?
cards.a: PAP sends the password in clear text, is one-way, weak, and does not re-authenticate. CHAP uses a hashed challenge/response, is stronger, and re-authenticates periodically.

cards.q: Which PPP authentication is more secure and why?
cards.a: CHAP is stronger because it never sends clear passwords — it uses a challenge/response hash and re-authenticates periodically, unlike PAP which transmits the password in the clear.

cards.q: What is the command to enable PPP encapsulation on a serial interface?
cards.a: encapsulation ppp under the interface, which enables PPP on that serial interface.

cards.q: What does the ppp authentication chap command do?
cards.a: Forces CHAP as the authentication method on the PPP interface, and the shared secret is set with ppp chap password.

cards.q: What is Multilink PPP (MLPPP) and what does it do?
cards.a: MLPPP bonds multiple links into one logical pipe to achieve higher bandwidth; LCP handles fragmentation and it supports QoS on the bundles, commonly combining serial/T1 links.

cards.q: Which commands verify a PPP link and debug authentication?
cards.a: show interface Serial0/0/0 and show ppp multilink verify the link; debug ppp authentication and debug ppp negotiation troubleshoot authentication and negotiation.

cards.q: A PPP link is down and show interface fails before LCP. What is the likely cause and check?
cards.a: LCP failure or no clock is the likely cause; check show interface and ensure encapsulation ppp is set on the interface.

cards.q: A PPP link shows authentication failure. What is the likely cause and check?
cards.a: A secret mismatch is the likely cause; check with debug ppp authentication and verify the ppp chap password matches on both ends.

cards.q: No IP address is negotiated on the PPP link (IPCP failure). What is the likely cause and check?
cards.a: NCP (IPCP) being blocked is the likely cause; check with debug ppp negotiation.
